promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a streamlined account opening process that allows customers to open an account in as little as 2 minutes. The service is available to both Hong Kong residents and visitors in Hong Kong with zero deposit requirements.

promotions.title: Fund Redemption Fee Waiver
promotions.highlight: 🆓 Redemption fee waivers for all funds
promotions.description: ZA Bank customers who have activated fund trading services can enjoy redemption fee waivers for all funds until July 31, 2026. This allows investors to redeem their fund investments without paying any redemption fees.
promotions.quota: All retail banking users who have activated fund trading services

promotions.title: ZA Bank Payment Connect Cross-Border Transfer
promotions.highlight: 🌏 Fee-free real-time transfers between Mainland China and Hong Kong
promotions.description: Send money between Mainland China and Hong Kong in real-time with zero fees using Payment Connect. Instant cross-border transfers without any handling charges.

promotions.title: New Stock Trading Customer Cash Rewards
promotions.highlight: 💵 Up to HKD 1,500 in cash rewards for new stock traders
promotions.description: New users can receive up to HKD 500 in cash rewards for opening an account, plus up to HKD 1,000 in cash rebates for buying stocks. This offer is specifically for Hong Kong stock trading customers.
promotions.cost: Must buy stocks to qualify for portion of rewards

promotions.title: Second 20% p.a. Time Deposit for Multi-Product Usage
promotions.highlight: 🔄 Additional 20% p.a. time deposit for using multiple products
promotions.description: New referred customers who hold deposits, funds, and stocks with a total balance of at least HKD 1,000 within 14 days of opening an account can receive an additional +19.9% p.a. 7-day HKD time deposit interest rate booster coupon, providing a second opportunity to enjoy 20% p.a. interest.
promotions.quota: New referred customers using multiple products

promotions.title: Currency Exchange Discount Voucher
promotions.highlight: 💱 Receive HKD 126 currency exchange discount voucher
promotions.description: New customers can receive a HKD 126 currency exchange discount voucher valid for 30 days after receipt. This voucher can be used to reduce the cost of currency exchange transactions within ZA Bank.
promotions.quota: New customers who open accounts with referral codes

best_for.detail: $0 commission trading on Hong Kong stocks forever (ongoing for eligible accounts). Zero platform fees - total cost HKD 0/trade for HKEX-listed securities.
best_for.why_others_lose: ZA Bank charges HKD 18 platform fee per trade (despite $0 commission), making total cost HKD 18/trade. PAObank charges 0.15% commission. Airstar's HKD 0 total cost is the lowest.

best_for.detail: $0 brokerage commission for US stocks via ZA Invest with platform fee USD 0.0099/share (min USD 1.99/trade). Total cost at 200 shares: USD 1.99.
best_for.why_others_lose: PAObank charges USD 0.012/share commission (no platform fees). At 200 shares PAO costs USD 2.40 vs ZA USD 1.99. ZA wins for trades ≥166 shares. Airstar offers fractional US share investing but specific fee structure isn't detailed in the data.

best_for.detail: $0 platform fee for crypto trading for the first 90 days for new customers. Active promotion from 2026-02-01 to 2026-06-30.
best_for.why_others_lose: No other virtual banks in the data offer cryptocurrency trading promotions or services.

best_for.detail: StockBack program offers stock rewards instead of cash - up to 6% StockBack on coffee shop purchases (until 2026-04-21), 2.5% StockBack for new customers (until 2026-06-30), and PowerDraw with up to 200% rebate chance.
best_for.why_others_lose: Mox offers 2% Unlimited CashBack (ongoing) but ZA's StockBack offers higher rates (up to 6%) for specific categories and chance for up to 200% rebate through PowerDraw, plus the unique equity ownership benefit.

best_for.detail: HKD 2,026 reward package plus 2.5% StockBack for new customers who use appropriate invitation codes. Additional HKD 800 in fund holding rebate vouchers available. Valid until 2026-05-27.
best_for.why_others_lose: Mox offers up to HKD 1,500 cash reward with invitation code 1500MOX, which is less than ZA Bank's HKD 2,026 package plus additional benefits.

best_for.detail: MOXTRIP25 promotion: earn up to 28,500 miles through spending and saving. Also offers Trip.com discounts up to 8% off + up to 2% Unlimited CashBack and Travel Pick & Go insurance with free add-on coverage. Valid until 2026-06-30.
best_for.why_others_lose: ZA Bank offers year-round travel offers with ZA Card but doesn't specify mileage earning potential or specific discounts like Mox's 8% off Trip.com bookings and free insurance add-on coverage.

best_for.detail: Personal loans with APR from 7.43%, with loan amounts up to 12x monthly salary. Ongoing permanent feature.
best_for.why_others_lose: WeLab offers personal loans with cash rebate up to HKD 23,888 but doesn't specify a lower starting APR than Airstar's 7.43%. ZA Bank mentions loan approval in 90 seconds but doesn't specify a competitive APR rate.

best_for.detail: WeLab Global Wallet offers the 'Best Exchange Rates Guarantee' in town as a permanent feature. This is more competitive than other multi-currency offerings.
best_for.why_others_lose: ZA Bank offers Payment Connect with zero-fee transfers to 140+ countries but doesn't guarantee best exchange rates. Airstar Bank offers zero handling fee for first remittance to mainland China but this is a limited-time offer without a best-rate guarantee.

best_for.detail: 0% subscription fee on ALL funds with no cap until July 31, 2026. No restrictions on fund types or transaction amounts.
best_for.why_others_lose: WeLab offers $0 subscription fees but only for 'Featured Funds'. Mox has 0% fund subscription fee until June 30, 2026 (shorter period). Ant Bank waives transaction fees but doesn't specify if this applies to all funds.

best_for.detail: HKD 800 per successful loan referral through the 'R-Friend Referral' campaign, valid until June 30, 2026.
best_for.why_others_lose: ZA Bank's referral program allows earning 'up to HKD 90,000' by referring friends, but doesn't specify the per-referral amount, making it harder to evaluate for small numbers of referrals compared to WeLab's guaranteed HKD 800 per successful referral.
